notes.title: DRIFTING KINGS IS OUT!
notes.notes:
After 2+ years of development, I am incredibly happy to finally have reached this important milestone.

[b]Drifting kings is out now.[/b] 

You’ll finally be able to get your hands on the full game.

Enjoy, have fun with your friends and Stay Sideways!

[b]Make sure to join the official Discord server[/b] : https://discord.gg/VWjHRmX8vy

notes.title: Demo
notes.notes:
1. Vehicle physics tweak and update.
2. Controls updated

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is now over, thank you everyone who tried the demo! and for those that haven't yet tried  don't worry i know there was a LOT of demos and its impossible to try it all in 7 days so the demo will be live and stay live and updated regularly until the day of launch, 

Thank you again and remember to stay sideways!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Steam Racing Fest has ended and Steam Next Fest is coming up, many people tried the demo during Steam Racing Fest which is awesome.

It's awesome to hear that many of you enjoyed it.

But of course some constructive criticism was also received, which is also much appreciated.

Fixed all reported bugs plus minor changes and did some major visual updates in the new demo, it will be available in steam next fest hope you enjoy it.



Thank you!

notes.title: Steam Racing Fest
notes.notes:
Hey there Drifters!

Drifting Kings will be part of the Steam Racing Fest with the demo starting May 23rd!

So this past week I was working a lot on the demo , the major update was adding (Crazy Moe) the tutorial dude to the demo(he's a nice guy but also he has some loose screws that need to be fixed lol ːsteamhappyː) to get ready for Steam Racing Fest plus minor bugs fixed, Environment tweaks and general optimization for the game.





Remember.......Stay sideways.....
